aside.registeredBody: Sign in to use your saved details.

benefits.track: Steam sign-in links your account for delivery
benefits.addresses: Your purchases and their delivery status in one place
benefits.saved: Save skins to come back to

meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to your Patinaskins account to see your orders, Steam delivery status and saved items.

login.title: Sign in
login.checkoutHint: Sign in to check out. Your cart stays as it is.
login.failed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
login.steamFailed: Steam sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
login.steamNote: Steam confirms your Steam ID to us. We never see your Steam password.

meta.title: Create an account
meta.description: Create a Patinaskins account to buy Counter-Strike 2 skins and follow their delivery to your Steam account.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Three short steps. We use these details for your invoice and to confirm you're old enough to order. You link your Steam account afterwards.
register.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}
register.restricted: We don't open accounts or sell in {countries}.
register.terms: I have read and agree to the <link>Terms and Conditions</link>
register.privacy: We handle your details as described in our <link>Privacy policy</link>.
register.failed: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.
register.steamAlternative: Prefer not to use a password? <link>Sign in through Steam</link> instead.

meta.title: Reset your password
meta.description: Request a link to reset your Patinaskins password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email address you use for your account and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Check your spam folder if it hasn't arrived in a few minutes.
forgot.failed: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.

meta.title: Set a new password
meta.description: Choose a new password for your Patinaskins account.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.invalidTitle: This reset link has expired or has already been used
reset.invalidBody: Request a new link and use it within the time shown in the email.
reset.doneBody: Your new password is set. Sign in with it from now on.
reset.failed: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.
